selection.source: AI scanner (watchlist + picks), end of day
selection.rule: The scanner's merged list (watchlist and picks, picks win for entry, stop and target), ranked by the scanner's score, then only stocks that pass the scan snapshot's eligibility gates (a price and previous close, 20-session traded value, reference data, series EQ or BE, not an ETF, price band at least 10%, not at its band limit, and traded value of at least Rs 10 crore a day); the top N that pass. When the snapshot cannot be read, the scanner's own liquid flag (the same crore gate on its 20-session average) is the only gate.
selection.excluded_note: Only setups ranked above the last selected one are listed.

ideas_response.ranking_note: Ideas keep the scanner's rank: its rules-based score, which is a rank and not a probability. Within an idea, `preferred` is the viable strategy with the best net reward : risk at the conservative level. Reward : risk of a hedged or income structure (a long put or a short call changes the loss at the stop) is not comparable with an unhedged one: read max loss and capital at risk beside it. No probability and no composite score is produced. With Chartink included, ideas the AI scanner lists come first, ranked by its score; stocks only Chartink listed follow them, ranked by the number of your enabled bullish Chartink scans that listed them and then by traded value. A scan count is not a probability and not a score; your Chartink scans are your own screens and have not been validated.

combinations.short_call_strike: the call wall (largest call open interest) when it lies above the at-the-money strike, else the first listed strike at or beyond spot + one expected move
combinations.long_put_strike: the listed out-of-the-money put strike nearest the stop (the scanner's stop, else the chart engine's ATR stop)
combinations.future: the futures contract that expires on the options expiry (a synthetic call needs matching expiries)
combinations.shares: lots x lot size shares, at the last close; if the stock is already held, the shares leg is that position priced at the last close
combinations.reward_risk: reward = P&L at the gate scenario level, risk = loss if the price reaches the stop (both from the payoff calculation); a long put or a short call changes that loss, so the ratio is not comparable with an unhedged cash idea: read max loss and capital at risk beside it. combinations.sizing: lots = floor(risk budget / loss per lot at the stop (the cash stop distance x lot size when the premium covers it)), capped by the allocation cap on the deployed value per lot (shares or futures notional plus the net premium)

sizing.formula: units = the most whole lots with units x risk per unit + estimated round-trip costs at the stop (the desk cost card) <= risk budget, capped by floor(capital x max allocation % / entry value per unit); for an option structure the risk per unit is already its worst net loss

chartink.ranking: Chartink-only ideas follow the AI scanner's ideas; they are ranked by the number of enabled bullish Chartink scans that listed the stock, then by 20-session traded value. That is a count of the user's own scans, not a probability and not a score.

chartink.evidence: technical.chartink_scans: a bullish-tagged scan hit supports a bullish view and conflicts with a bearish one, a bearish-tagged hit the reverse; hits of both tags are neutral; no hit is neutral; no dashboard, a stale or failed refresh is unavailable
chartink.cash_rule: A stock the scanner lists in no bucket, with at least one enabled bullish Chartink hit, gets a cash candidate whose stop, targets and sizing come from the chart engine's ATR rule (ATR_2X_STOP); the same reward : risk, liquidity and event gates as every other candidate apply
chartink.levels_label: rule-based levels; the scan is the user's Chartink scan, not validated

chartink_picks.label: evidence score — not a probability
chartink_picks.rule: Each Chartink stock that passes the scan-snapshot eligibility gates is scored on scan confluence, trend (EMA), momentum (MACD, 20-day change, RSI), relative volume, liquidity, F&O open-interest build-up (F&O stocks), fundamentals quality, event risk (results inside the horizon), distance from its 52-week extremes and ATR risk. A figure that could not be read earns nothing and is listed as unavailable. Thin or conflicting evidence, a score under the minimum, or a strategy plan that says wait or no trade, is Wait / No trade and the stock is not a pick. Strategies come from the Strategy Builder's plan; options are defined risk only and nothing is sent to a broker.

per_trade_risk_pct.breach: the size is REDUCED to the largest valid quantity or lot count within the budget; if even the smallest valid quantity exceeds it, the entry is BLOCKED (min_qty_exceeds_budget)

max_open_risk_pct.label: Total open risk
max_open_risk_pct.basis: estimated risk reserved by every open position (paper_accounts.open_risk_rs, plus positions opened before Phase 1 at their stored levels) plus the new entry, as % of paper equity
max_open_risk_pct.reset: falls as positions close, are cancelled or expire
max_open_risk_pct.breach: REDUCED to fit the remaining budget, else BLOCKED (open_risk_exceeded)

max_position_pct.label: Position exposure
max_position_pct.basis: market exposure (notional: quantity x entry for shares, futures notional and the options' capital at risk for a structure) of the new position, as % of paper equity
max_position_pct.breach: REDUCED to fit, else BLOCKED (POSITION_SIZE / position_exceeded)

max_sector_pct.label: Sector exposure
max_sector_pct.basis: market exposure of every open position in the instrument's sector (NSE industry classification) plus the new one, as % of paper equity; a position with no known sector blocks the entry
max_sector_pct.reset: falls as positions in the sector close

daily_loss_pct.label: Daily loss halt
daily_loss_pct.basis: loss since the start of the IST trading day: net realised P&L of trades closed today plus the change in net unrealised P&L of the positions held since the previous session's close, as % of start-of-day equity
daily_loss_pct.reset: the next IST trading day (weekday calendar)
daily_loss_pct.breach: new entries BLOCKED for the rest of the day (daily_loss_halt); open positions untouched

weekly_loss_pct.label: Weekly loss halt
weekly_loss_pct.basis: the same loss measured from the close of the last session before Monday of the ISO week (IST), as % of start-of-week equity
weekly_loss_pct.breach: new entries BLOCKED until the week resets (weekly_loss_halt); open positions untouched

max_drawdown_pct.label: Drawdown halt
max_drawdown_pct.basis: fall of paper equity from the configured equity peak: the starting capital, raised by every higher equity the risk service observes, never lowered
max_drawdown_pct.reset: never resets daily; only a person (an admin) resets the peak or loosens the limit
max_drawdown_pct.breach: new entries BLOCKED (drawdown_halt); open positions are NOT liquidated

min_reward_risk.label: Minimum reward:risk
min_reward_risk.basis: (gain at the target - estimated costs) / (loss at the stop + estimated costs); options: maximum gain at expiry over maximum loss, both after costs; unbounded gain passes
min_reward_risk.breach: BLOCKED (reward_risk_too_low); an entry with no target where one is needed is BLOCKED (target_required)

notes.cash_ranking: Ideas keep the scanner's rank: its rules-based score, which is a rank and not a probability. Within an idea, `preferred` is the viable strategy with the best net reward : risk at the conservative level. Reward : risk of a hedged or income structure (a long put or a short call changes the loss at the stop) is not comparable with an unhedged one: read max loss and capital at risk beside it. No probability and no composite score is produced. With Chartink included, ideas the AI scanner lists come first, ranked by its score; stocks only Chartink listed follow them, ranked by the number of your enabled bullish Chartink scans that listed them and then by traded value. A scan count is not a probability and not a score; your Chartink scans are your own screens and have not been validated.
cash_caveats: Conditional research ideas, not advice and not an instruction to trade.
End-of-day data: nothing here is live. F&O data is one NSE bhavcopy per day.
Payoff figures are calculations at the prices shown, not forecasts; taxes, statutory charges, dividends and funding are excluded.
Margin is not estimated by the plan: it comes only from Zerodha's margin calculator, which needs a live Kite session. Margin is not the maximum loss.
Nothing is sent to a broker.
notes.fno_ranking: Ranked by fit to the market regime measured on the dates shown and by the live end-of-day option chain, then by reward : risk. This is not a forecast, not a probability, and not a ranking by past performance: no strategy performance is recorded for options in this system. Nothing here is an instruction to trade and nothing is sent to a broker.
fno_gaps: No IV percentile or IV rank: no option-implied-volatility history is stored, so 'rich' and 'cheap' volatility use India VIX against the desk-regime threshold (desk-regime-v1 vix_high), not a percentile of this underlying's own IV.
No performance ranking: the only realised records are three manual cash backtests (public.strategy_trades); there is no options performance history, so no idea here can be ranked by what it earned.
End of day only: the chain is the NSE F&O bhavcopy close. There is no intraday option data.
An index has no cash leg: NIFTY and BANKNIFTY cannot be held, so covered calls, protective puts and collars are offered for stocks only.
notes.fno_staleness: The option chain is from 2026-10-21 but the market regime was last classified on 2026-10-19: the fit is scored against the older regime.
